high_level_description: This image shows a close-up of a window on the side of a building. The wall is painted white but has some areas where the paint is peeling off, revealing patches of the underlying material. The window itself has dark green shutters that are open, allowing a view into the interior. Inside the window, there is a wooden-framed window with six panes. The window is partially covered by sheer white curtains with lace trim at the bottom. On the windowsill, there is a small potted plant with pink flowers, adding a touch of color to the scene. A decorative owl figurine is also placed on the windowsill
